name: 086.1 — every :on hands back a Sub
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 086.1: a slash command, a hotkey and a selector watch each hand back the same Sub — userdata that prints Sub(<key>), answers :key() and ends with an idempotent :off() — sub:remove() raises naming :off(), the three retired spellings each name their replacement, and the registry's own name refusal still fires.
